basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer · Python/TypeScript · AWS (SecurityHub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail) · Event-Driven Systems · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.experian-sse: Senior Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python, TypeScript, AWS cloud-native services, and event-driven architectures. Authored AWS log-source tables and detections for CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SecurityHub at Turbot HQ, and built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline, contributing to a platform that cut enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Authored 11 AWS log-source tables for Tailpipe in Go — including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, ALB access logs, and S3 access logs — plus 25+ pre-built security detections, working directly with the same AWS observability and security services this role centers on.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data.

Built a RAG-based Pydantic AI agent with a knowledge base ingested into S3 vector storage; deployed it as a serverless AWS Lambda function and integrated it with the Slack Bot API for instant developer access.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was enforced; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for retry and investigation.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL (AWS RDS) queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service, the same root-cause discipline an on-call rotation demands.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Built end to end in 4 days: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend on Vercel; Nakama game server (Go core + TS runtime) on Fly.io with PostgreSQL. Server-authoritative anti-cheat over WebSocket transport, mode-aware matchmaking via KV-storage queues, and optimistic UI with revert-on-validation-failure.
